title: Legacy SPP mapping profile (v1)
summary: Historical mapping conventions for SPP-style rounds and corpus adapters. Does not claim that historic SPP artifacts followed GDI contemporaneously.

phase2Policy.notes: Legacy retrospective mapping does not invent Phase II evidence.

policySourceCapture.notes: Capture exact public/authorized bytes when available; otherwise mark unknown with reason.

operatorConfirmations.description: Confirm mapping of available public artifacts to decision surfaces, or mark unknown.

Confirm whether missing historical fields are unavailable, protected, or unknown.

nonGoals: No claim that historic SPP rounds used GDI contemporaneously.
No fabrication of missing fields to force validation pass.
No merit scoring of historical applications.
No ENS endorsement from retrospective reconstruction.

burdenBudget.intent: Stable adapter boundary for corpus and historical examples.

legacyMapping.disclaimer: This profile encodes mapping conventions for retrospective compatibility. It MUST NOT be read as evidence that historic SPP artifacts followed GDI contemporaneously.
conventions: Map public forum/proposal/decision artifacts to the five surfaces only with operator confirmation.
Preserve eligibility dispositions separately from merit evaluations when both are observable.
Leave unknown fields as unknown; do not convert unknown to pass.
Record field-level provenance as direct, derived, interpretive, or unknown.
